Treatment Summary
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with a
cervical strain. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of conservative management including gentle range-of-motion
exercises, soft tissue therapy, and instruction in a home stretching program. The injury mechanism described is a plausible
explanation for the symptoms reported. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness
that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and reflex testing were within normal limits. No prior injury to the
cervical region is known from the patient's history. The course of treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency
tapering as pain and mobility improved. Billing records relfect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated
entries.
